plan.label: Planning

bookings.emptyText: Enter a transaction or import your bank statement.
budget.invalid: Enter an amount such as 250 or 99.90.
budget.enterHint: Enter a monthly amount for a category on the right.

profile.car: Drive to work in your own car
tax.copyFailed: Copying is not possible. Select the amount by hand.
tax.detailsNote: These feed into flat rates and limits. Changes apply immediately.

toast.fixedDeleted: Fixed cost deleted; earlier transactions remain
fixed.errStart: Enter the month of the first booking.
fixed.errOrder: The last booking is before the first one.
import.intro: Choose a bank statement as a PDF, or the transactions as a CSV file from your online banking. Transactions you have already imported are recognised and skipped. The statement stays on your device; only the transactions are saved.
import.chooseFile: Choose a PDF or CSV file
import.tooBig: The file is larger than 5 MB.
import.pdfPassword: The statement is password-protected. Save it without a password or use the CSV export.
import.pdfUnreadable: The PDF file could not be read.
import.pdfEmpty: No transactions were recognised in this PDF (scanned statements contain no text). Otherwise use your bank's CSV export.
import.loadFailed: Your existing transactions could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.

import.summary.other: {n} transactions recognised, {fresh} of them new and {assigned} assigned automatically.
